Gurmeet Chaudhary and Isha Malviya Star in 'Tum Mere Ho'

The romantic drama film 'Tum Mere Ho', starring Gurmeet Chaudhary and Isha Malviya, explores themes of love, betrayal, marriage, and the complexities of relationships. This marks the first on-screen pairing of Chaudhary and Malviya. The movie is described as a romantic drama.
